turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.
I hear that you’re upset. I’ve passed your complaint to a colleague who will take over here in chat. Please don’t come to the studio to damage anything. You can tell us what went wrong here.

input.summary: Customer called studio staff thieves and liars and threatened to come to the studio and smash frames if ignored. Alert staff to the threat and follow up in chat to identify the underlying issue. No order details were provided.
